verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a data/read API that lists faults for a project, plus ingestion endpoints for exceptions, source maps and deploys. Its hosted MCP server exposes project management, error investigation and BadgerQL queries, so a meaningful share of UI functions is reachable programmatically. Nothing shows the API matches the UI, though: alarms, anomaly detection, team/SAML management, account switching, integration setup, AI search and resolve/reopen are only documented as UI or Slack features, and no OpenAPI spec exists (all probe paths 404). Missing for 10: documented API parity for alarm/integration/team/account management, write operations such as resolving or assigning faults via the API, and a published API spec or independent confirmation of coverage.
